Perform manual testing across web and software applications to identify functional, usability, compatibility, and performance issues. Execute test cases and accurately document test results. Identify, investigate, and report software defects with clear descriptions, screenshots, severity levels, and detailed steps to reproduce. Track defects throughout their lifecycle and collaborate with developers to verify fixes and perform regression testing. Assist in creating, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts. Gain hands-on experience with tools such as Selenium and JMeter. Perform regression, functional, integration, and exploratory testing when required. Collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to improve overall product quality. Support continuous improvements to QA processes, documentation, and testing standards. Stay up to date with emerging QA methodologies, automation tools, testing frameworks, and software development technologies. Strong understanding of software development and software testing principles. (Mandatory) Familiarity with Manual Testing, Selenium, and JMeter. (Mandatory) Basic understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). Understanding of test cases, test scenarios, defect reporting, regression testing, and functional testing. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality work. Ability to learn new technologies and tools quickly. Good communication and documentation skills. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team. Added Advantages Knowledge or exposure to any of the following would be beneficial: API testing tools such as Postman Bug and project management tools such as Jira Basic programming or scripting knowledge Git and version control Agile/Scrum development environments CI/CD concepts Test automation frameworks What You'll Gain at CreativeX Technology Joining CreativeX Technology as a QA Intern will give you the opportunity to turn your academic knowledge into practical industry experience. You'll receive: Hands-on QA experience working with real software products and projects. Exposure to both manual and automated software testing. Mentorship and guidance from experienced technology professionals. Opportunities to work on challenging and impactful projects. Practical experience with modern QA tools, methodologies, and workflows. Exposure to the complete software development lifecycle. A collaborative, supportive, and learning-focused work environment. Continuous opportunities to strengthen your technical and professional skills. Exposure to modern software development technologies and industry best practices. Opportunities to collaborate with developers and other technology professionals. Valuable industry networking and career-development opportunities. Who Should Apply? This opportunity is ideal for students who are passionate about software quality, testing, problem-solving, and technology and who want to build a strong foundation for a career in Software Quality Assurance and Test Automation. Join CreativeX Technology and start building your career in Quality Assurance.
